II

Functionality

Operational logic that is not specific to one tab type.

1. Application lifecycle · 2 maps

Application shutdownFunctionality

Persist window and session state, detach active workspaces, stop relay intake, and flush the log.

Application startupFunctionality

Initialize shared services, restore persisted state, recover work, and show the main window.

2. Media discovery and import · 2 maps

Detect adjacent LosslessCut projectFunctionality

Inspect adjacent LosslessCut projects in order and transfer an accepted candidate to the import operation.

Import LosslessCut projectFunctionality

Validate a LosslessCut project against active media, let the user choose replace or append, and commit imported sections.

3. Keyframes and waveform · 5 maps

Move to nearest keyframeFunctionality

Compare the adjacent timestamps in the complete stored keyframe set and move immediately when either side has a candidate, without first confirming local scan coverage.

Move to next keyframeFunctionality

Resolve the earliest stored keyframe after the cursor and move immediately when any candidate exists, without first confirming that the cursor region has been scanned.

Move to previous keyframeFunctionality

Resolve the latest stored keyframe before the cursor and move immediately when any candidate exists, without first confirming that the cursor region has been scanned.

Scan nearby keyframesFunctionality

Load cached keyframes for a source, concurrently scan the centre and both directional ranges around the cursor, and publish source-current results.

Suspend keyframe scanningFunctionality

Cancel and dispose the active keyframe scan request without discarding accumulated keyframes.

4. Queue and scheduling · 13 maps

Add work to scheduleFunctionality

Persist built work records as pending items, assign routing and lineage, and notify schedule observers.

Apply runner configurationFunctionality

Copy the current renderer, parallelism, pause-on-failure, and retry preferences into a station runner before starting it.

Cancel running workFunctionality

Confirm cancellation of currently running items, disable automatic execution, and arm per-item cancellation; only a nonzero observed exit becomes cancelled storage.

Claim queued workFunctionality

Select the next eligible pending item, move it to running state, and establish ownership and lease data.

Clear all non-running workFunctionality

Confirm and remove all clearable durable work while preserving work that cannot safely be cleared.

Clear all tab contentsFunctionality

Confirm the command, clear viewer, file-list, and group state in every tab, and show why section state is cleared only for the active workspace.

Clear completed workFunctionality

Confirm and remove durable completed work records from the shared schedule.

Load scheduleFunctionality

Reconcile the persistent depot and index into the observable worklist.

Recover stale claimsFunctionality

Resolve running records whose owner or lease is stale and either requeue or fail them according to recovery limits.

Remove work recordFunctionality

The selected work item no longer exists in the worklist.

Reset cancelled or failed workFunctionality

The work item is pending with a fresh retry and recovery history.

Switch worklist stationFunctionality

Move the console to the previous or next station and refresh progress and controls for that station.

Toggle automatic executionFunctionality

Enable or disable automatic execution for the active station and persist the preference.

5. Processing and FFmpeg · 7 maps

Complete processingFunctionality

Commit a finished job as done or failed, reload observable state, apply failure-pausing policy, and clean temporary resources.

Handle source and output path collisionFunctionality

Trace work creation and collision handling when an output path can equal one of its source paths, including the destructive failure paths under Rename existing and Overwrite.

Pause processingFunctionality

No new work is claimed; suspendable active processes are paused.

Retry failed jobFunctionality

Apply retry policy to a failed running item and release it back to pending state when another attempt is allowed.

Run FFmpeg jobFunctionality

Validate one claimed item, run its FFmpeg stages, and commit success, retry, cancellation, or failure according to the path actually reached.

Start processingFunctionality

Workers are running or resumed and schedule observers see the new state.

Stop processingFunctionality

Active work is returned to the queue and this runner owns no claims.

6. Relay and routing · 2 maps

Deliver completed outputFunctionality

Deliver a completed output, optionally drain its source tab, and show how an inactive source tab can retain flow sections after its file and viewer are removed.

Receive relayed tabFunctionality

Restore a startup relay payload or accept a live relay-channel payload as a new selected tab.

7. Project persistence · 7 maps

Delete named sceneFunctionality

Show the current scene-preset controls and the missing UI route to the existing persistent deletion method.

Export sceneFunctionality

Export a stored or current scene as a standalone JSON file selected by the user.

Import sceneFunctionality

Read a standalone scene JSON file, assign a collision-free name, and add it to the persisted scene collection.

Load named sceneFunctionality

Confirm replacement of the current window and rebuild it from one stored named scene.

Restore sessionFunctionality

Recreate tabs, per-tab output and layout state, names, relay routing, target resolution, selection, and optional last media.

Save named sceneFunctionality

Capture the current window as a named scene and persist it in the scene collection.

Save sessionFunctionality

Capture the current tab arrangement and workspace state and persist it as the next startup session.

8. Preferences and tools · 4 maps

Apply preferencesFunctionality

Collect the options draft, normalize and persist it, apply live settings, and notify when a language change requires restart.

Discover FFmpeg libraryFunctionality

Choose the FFmpeg library used by Flyleaf from the explicit preference, stored renderer setting, or discovered local installation.

Install local FlyleafFunctionality

Clone or update Flyleaf, patch the contrast shader, build it, and install the resulting runtime for Cadroue.

Persist preference changeFunctionality

Coalesce high-frequency preference changes and write the latest normalized preference state after the defer interval.

9. Logging · 2 maps

Emit log entryFunctionality

Create a structured trace entry, publish it to live viewers, enqueue its text, and flush batches to the active log file.

Open log feedFunctionality

Load a selected log file into structured rows, apply category filtering, and append live entries in bounded batches.
